findings: The current runner is naive layer-wise model parallelism, not data-parallel or sharded distributed training.
Accepted artifacts remain scientifically usable because exact data, model, objective, device binding and prediction contracts passed.
The topology is operationally inefficient and should not be copied into a new training hypothesis without a runtime preflight.
Changing to ordinary token-level SFT would change the scientific objective and is not a technical retry.
